purpose: Critique the pilot's cockpit work of the day and the approved plan from two angles: fit with the cockpit's purpose and corpus; bulk that can be trimmed without losing function

seats.name: fit-critic
seats.returns: 13 then 7 findings; three high, all against the plan

seats.name: trim-critic
seats.reason: measuring bulk against function is judgement
seats.returns: 17 findings; the three biggest recurring costs named

shape: two independent angles in parallel, no cross-talk by design; each re-read after the room changed under it
outcome: Plan reshaped on the fit-critic's three high findings (crew cannot write where the plan sends them; docspec would restate rule 2; a third home for the commander's words). Trim-critic's three top cuts made: orders to JSON, session log capped, map trimmed. Second passes found seven pointer breaks from the dispatch rebuild, all fixed.
lessons: two independent angles found different things; keep them independent
run the critique before building: every high finding was against the plan, not the files
tell critics at dispatch that the ground may move and to re-read before reporting
a change made in one room must be made in every room that points into it
